desc:
Prehistoria is a developing dinosaur survival game where players can customize their character, survive and complete quests to earn more species and customization options

🎨 Customize your character with many different colors!
💰 Unlock new creatures!
🏞️ Explore a detailed map (roughly 60% complete)
🖥️ Play on PC, phone or tablet
📱 Optimized for slow phones!

CURRENTLY IN EARLY BETA AND LACKING MANY MAIN FEATURES
This game has a small team and development may be slow!

⭐ RECENT UPDATES ⭐
> Added Quests!
> Halloween Event skins are back! NEW CONCAVENATOR EVENT SKIN
> Added Ceratosaurus
> Added Territories
> Added Redwoods
> Added Badlands
